evals.prompt: Build a repeatable capacity test for our HTTP API. We care about sustainable RPS below p99 100 ms and 1% errors, and want the result to be comparable after optimization.
evals.expected_output: Defines open-loop offered load and threshold semantics; records environment/commit/tool versions and repeats; measures offered/delivered rate, percentiles, errors and resources; reports last healthy and first failing step without claiming production capacity from localhost.

evals.prompt: Can I run k6, oha, and the soak test at the same time to finish faster? They all target localhost.
evals.expected_output: Explains interference and generator/target contention invalidate comparable measurements; recommends exclusive or deliberately isolated runs, records topology, and validates the load generator's capacity.
